reply_text:
Installed GBrain v0.60.757.0 in your existing Hermes profile using the pinned release binary. Your identity, existing instructions, and native Hermes memory were preserved. Setup added the GBrain memory rule and a per-turn hook. The local PGLite brain at /harness-state/.gbrain/brain.pglite is keyless: keyword retrieval works, with no embeddings or paid enrichment enabled.

Verified with real GBrain calls: `remember` committed synthetic fact #1 with provenance `install-check`. Separate processes retrieved it by exact text and through the configured MCP server. `forget` then withdrew it, and a final recall returned zero matches. Hermes passed its MCP connection and hook checks. A fresh Hermes chat timed out, so recall from a new conversation remains unverified.

Search mode is `conservative` now: 4K token budget, up to 10 chunks, no reranker. `balanced` allows 12K tokens and 25 chunks; `tokenmax` allows up to 50 chunks with no token cap. Neither enables paid providers by itself.

    Estimated downstream model input cost at 10,000 queries/month
                    Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
    conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
    balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
    tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

These are illustrative API estimates, not Hermes subscription prices. Keep `conservative` or choose `balanced` or `tokenmax` anytime.

Automatic fact saving is off. Free idle upkeep and the local redacted conversation archive are on by default. To disable the archive, use `~/.local/bin/gbrain transcripts archive off`. Hosted GBrain at https://gbrain.io is an optional alternative; it wasn’t used.
